content.text: One story: everything that is NEW starts at the marker and names the same release.

input.headline: The checkout release at the marker cannot read DATABASE_URL and is failing on every request path that loads config.
input.likely_cause: The new release renamed or dropped the DATABASE_URL key (ConfigMap or env) that config.py line 42 still expects; the payments timeouts are a downstream effect of checkout retrying without a database.
next_checks: kubectl get configmap checkout -o yaml | grep -n DATABASE
